corrections.text: The article says "In October, System76's COSMIC desktop added a similar rule." The Register's report, dated 7 October 2026, says COSMIC "has changed its contributors' guidelines" and the latest version has the no-AI rule, but it does not say when the change was made.

The article says the limited LLM contributions GCC accepts "must be clearly marked" and refers to "clear marking of any accepted LLM contribution in GCC." Phoronix quotes the GCC policy as requiring clear marking for legally insignificant contributions generated by an LLM; the quoted exception for legally significant contributions to test cases states no marking condition.
